text:
Maya: dropping new "card gallery" mock for /models/compare — mobile-first. Two main questions: 1) where do filters live on mobile (bottom sheet vs modal) 2) is the 'version anchor' UX discoverable? mock: <link>
Jon: Card gallery is clean. On desktop we should default to a dense matrix (table-like) but keep a visible toggle in the list header that remembers per-user.
Priya: Filters: bottom sheet on mobile, collapsible left rail on desktop. Always show active filters as small chips inline with search so state is visible.
Sam: Version anchor (current pin concept) is too hidden. Suggest a small left badge that reads "Anchored" when set, plus a hover/click affordance "Anchor this version". Also support checkbox select for multi-compare flows.
A11yBot: Accessibility nits: badge pills don't meet contrast ratio on light theme. Use 4.5:1 or add strong outline. Provide aria-labels like "Latency p95 74ms" and include sr-only text for icons.
Maya: Copy tweak for badges: change "Perf 74" -> "Latency (p95): 74ms" and add tooltip with workload + dataset.
Priya: Keyboard flow: bottom-sheet open/close needs focus trap. Ensure toggle is focusable, checkboxes announce state, and add skip link "Skip to compare".
Jon: Backend note: per-user toggle should persist to /users/:id/preferences. For private deployments allow org override.
Sam: Microcopy: replace tooltip "Pin" with "Anchor version to catalog" and show a snackbar "Version anchored" with undo. Also expose anchor state in model details page.
DesignNotifier: Reminder: design review meeting Thurs 10am to walk through a11y checklist and Figma frames.
Maya: Decisions: 1) support card gallery (mobile) + dense matrix (desktop) with persistent header toggle, 2) filters = bottom sheet mobile + rail desktop + header chips, 3) anchor affordance = visible left badge + inline action + checkbox for multi-select + undo snackbar, 4) badges = explicit copy + contrast + aria-labels + hover details, 5) keyboard flow + skip link + focus traps. I'll update the spec and ping eng for the prefs endpoint. :thumbsup:
